name: canva-grid
title: Visual Design Tool
description: Create visual designs — social posts, ads, presentations, stories, and more.
audience: Anyone who needs to create visual content — social media managers, small business owners, students, or anyone who wants a quick design tool without signing up for a service.
useCases: Create social media posts with images, text, and custom layouts
Design multi-page documents (slide decks, stories, booklets)
Apply preset themes and visual styles for quick professional results
Upload and arrange photos with overlays, filters, and logos

dataPrivacy.storage: Designs are created in the browser. Images are loaded from a CDN or uploaded locally.
dataPrivacy.thirdParty: Sample images served from canva-grid-assets CDN.
